_about.join: every DRAWN vertex takes the smallest containing rBodyData capsule on the bone it is skinned to, else the smallest containing capsule, else the nearest, in glb world space (capsule = boneWorld @ (point/100), radius/100). Slot indexes the dt_tune damage table.
_about.tables: read from the ROM .dtt: 8 rows x 10 bytes, table count = 2 - byte[0x12]. What a second table represents is NOT established -- do not name it.
_about.names: community part names (MHGU-Monster-Info verified sets), where they exist. The ROM has no part-name table.
_about.parts: per hit-zone slot, from the .dtt's own 10-byte part records at 0x3c: stagger, break (null when the part cannot break) and the kinsect extract colour. Verified against a reference table for Gammoth, all 8 parts on all 3 fields.
_about.slotsDefined: every damage slot an rBodyData capsule points at, placeholder rows excluded. Can be wider than slotsUsed (slots some drawn vertex was assigned): a zone nested inside a bigger capsule is never nearest, so never painted, but is still listed.
_about.partMap: the .bdd's own u16 at record+8: the .dtt part-record index for each capsule, against the u16 at +6 which is the damage-table row. The two index different part lists, so the bin carries a vertex map for each.
_about.bin: <em>.bin: u32 primCount, primCount x u32 vertexCount, then TWO equal blocks of one byte per vertex, concatenated in primitive order (the order the viewer counts prims in): first the damage-table slot, then the .dtt part-record index.
_about.capsules: the .bdd's own records, unbaked, so a zone can be drawn as the ROM defines it rather than through the vertex bake: [slot, part, shape, boneA, boneB, radius, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz] -- the damage-table row (record+6), the .dtt part-record index (+8), the shape (+4: 0 sphere on boneA at A, 1 capsule A..B both in boneA's space, 2 capsule A in boneA's space to B in boneB's), the two global bone ids (+0, +2; 255 = not bone-attached), then the radius and the two points in GAME units (floats at +16). Every record but the trailing sentinel, placeholder rows and unplaceable records included: the viewer skips what it cannot place.
